title: Gordon Bemis's Corn Cultivation Process Explained
reason: Describes the farming practices and processes for growing corn at Hutchins Farm.

tasks.task: Explain the crop rotation and composting practices at Hutchins Farm.

subtasks.text: Describe the crop rotation strategy, including never growing corn in the same land more than once in 3 years.

tasks.task: Detail the process of preparing the land for planting corn at Hutchins Farm.

subtasks.text: Mention the use of a mowboard plow for land preparation.
Describe the addition of compost made from horse manure, wood shavings, and chicken manure to the land.

tasks.task: Explain the cultivation practices used in corn fields at Hutchins Farm.

subtasks.text: Describe the use of a laly-tine weeder for the initial cultivation.
Explain the process of using the farm all H cultivating machine to push soil around the corn plant.

tasks.task: Describe weed management techniques used in the corn fields at Hutchins Farm.

subtasks.text: Mention the occasional hand weeding for large weeds.
Describe the practice of using the farm all C machine to push soil around the corn plant when necessary.

tasks.task: Outline insect control measures used in the corn fields at Hutchins Farm.

subtasks.text: Mention the use of BTs (Bacillus thuringiensis) for controlling the first generation European corn borer.
Describe the application of BT using a boom sprayer with a nozzle.
